Title: Recueil de divers témoignages de plusieurs cardinaux, archevêques, évêques, universités, facultés de théologie ou de droit, docteurs ... et autres personnes célèbres, en faveur de la catholicité et de la légitimité des droits du clergé, des chapitres, archevêques et évêques de l'Église catholique des Provinces-Unies, contre le schisme introduit dans cette Église depuis le commencement de ce siècle par les manœuvres des Jésuites et de leurs adhérents
Creator: Compiled for the Church of Utrecht; opens with the pastoral letter of Petrus Joannes Meindaerts, archbishop of Utrecht
Publisher: A Utrecht, chez G. Vander Weyde, libraire
Publication Date: 1763
Rights: Public Domain (published 1763, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item's own rights statement reads 'http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/')
Language: fra
Source: Internet Archive item bub_gb_cd8IIf4SvgMC (https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_cd8IIf4SvgMC), the item's own bub_gb_cd8IIf4SvgMC_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: National Library of Naples; host metadata date: 1763. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-23. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: 47efc65e1389981e185fc52328042260a04f67e47b232ea25a3c5fdc2e9d7772.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. National Library of Naples copy scanned by Google and contributed to the Internet Archive; usable OCR of old French with the long s as f; running heads and "Digitized by Google" lines interleaved.
Content note: The church's own apologetic dossier: Archbishop Meindaerts's pastoral letter presenting it, a preface on the schism, the testimonies of bishops, universities, canonists and others in favour of the chapter's rights and the succession from 1723, a précis of further testimonies, and a list of writings in the church's defence.
